hypotheses.H0: Macroscopic phase behavior in local many-body Hamiltonians is a smooth, additive function of microscopic constituents with no sharp scaling divergence or formal barrier between micro and macro descriptions.

H2 (Formal/Strong Emergence): Macroscopic phase properties can be formally undecidable from local microscopic Hamiltonians even without violating microscopic dynamics.
